name: ML Engineer Pack
description: Workflows for machine learning engineers: experiment tracking and reproducibility, data pipeline engineering, model serving, MLOps, and observability for ML systems.
useCases: Make ML experiments reproducible with tracked hyperparameters, metrics, artifacts, and environments.
Design data pipelines and serving APIs for training and inference workloads.
Add observability and tests around model training and serving to catch regressions.
examplePrompts: Set up experiment tracking for this training script so runs are reproducible and comparable.
Design a serving API for this model, including input validation, monitoring, and rollback strategy.
